name: KATA Design System
note: Source of truth for foundations. Runtime CSS lives in tokens.css (semantic --k- tokens); scales defined here are mirrored there. The /design-system/ page renders from this file.

roles.accent: #0e9594 (teal-500) — the single accent: links, success-adjacent highlights, the core of the mark
roles.core: #eb471f (vermillion) — the signature: the center of the mark, and the center of active controls (switch knob, radio dot). Never a surface, never text.

font.sans: Inter, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans JP, system-ui, sans-serif

motion.rule: Fast and small. No bounce, no overshoot. Motion explains a change; it never performs.

elevation.rule: Flat by default. Borders before shadows; shadows only for overlays and focus.

brand.usage: Seal color (the ink of a hanko stamp). Used only in the core of the KATA mark — header logo and favicon. Never in components, never as a UI accent.
